description:
Use this when the user has picked a coach from search_lessons and wants to see when that coach is free for a private lesson. Not for court times (search_courts).
Read-only: it shows the coach's open lesson times at one location and does not book anything. Pass the coach's listingId and the locationId from search_lessons (a coach who teaches at several places needs one). Optional: lessonLength in minutes (30, 60, 90 or 120; default the coach's usual length), startDate and endDate (YYYY-MM-DD, local days at the location; default the next 7 days, at most 14; times start 18 hours out, since coaches need that much notice), and earliestTime and latestTime (HH:MM, local) to narrow each day, for example evenings.
Returns the coach (with teachmeUrl, their own TeachMe.To page, where the player chooses a location, date and time themselves), the location and the coach's other locations, the lesson length, prices (TeachMe.To quotes for one student, fees included: one lesson, and the 10-lesson pack where the coach sells one; the exact total comes back with the checkout link) and open times grouped by local day, each with a slotKey and a checkoutUrl (TeachMe.To's checkout for that time with the coach, place and time already filled in: to book, share it exactly as returned; no contact details are needed). Times are in the location's own time zone. Each day shows a spread of its times and openTimes says how many there are in all; at most 4 days are shown.

earliestTime.description: Only times starting at or after this local time, HH:MM 24-hour (for example 17:00 for evenings).

endDate.description: Last day to show, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to a week from the first day; at most 14 days in all.

latestTime.description: Only times starting at or before this local time, HH:MM 24-hour.

lessonLength.description: Lesson length in minutes. Leave out for the coach's usual length.

locationId.description: The locationId from search_lessons (the coach's place nearest the user). Needed when the coach teaches at more than one place.

startDate.description: First day to show, YYYY-MM-DD, a local day at the location. Defaults to today.
